firstMessage:
`Sessions.login` and its lockout test are listed under `R-LOGIN-LOCKOUT`, which controls `RISK-ACCOUNT-TAKEOVER`. The project’s AGENTS.md requires approval before I change either one, so I’ve requested it. No files have changed. The existing accounts tests pass.

Once approved, I’ll make the fifth failed login throw `LockedError` with the lock expiry, update the test, and run the required test again.
finalMessage:
The fifth failed login now throws `LockedError` with the lock expiry, so the customer learns immediately that the account is locked. Earlier failed attempts still throw `BadCredentialsError`.

`R-LOGIN-LOCKOUT` remains true. I updated its `Sessions > locks the account after five failures` test and added a draft entry for the immediate notification. The draft has no ID because the project instructions prohibit inventing one.

The changed code touches `R-LOGIN-LOCKOUT` and its risk control, `RISK-ACCOUNT-TAKEOVER`, for pull request review. The required lockout test passes, and the full suite passes (36 tests).
